dedupe_keys.name: afac mexico civil aviation open data airport and airline operational statistics

description: Mexico's Federal Civil Aviation Agency (Agencia Federal de Aviación Civil, AFAC) publishes its civil aviation statistics as open data through the national portal datos.gob.mx. Its open data page lists six resources: an operational summary by airline, passenger operational statistics for 2024, airport operational statistics for 2024, a database of aerodromes and heliports for 2024, an operational summary for April 2023, and airport operational statistics from 2006 to April 2023. Together they give national coverage of Mexican airports and airlines, with a long airport series from 2006. Access is free through the linked datos.gob.mx resources. Caveats: the datos.gob.mx pages refused automated access on 2026-09-26, so the file formats, update frequency and licence terms could not be read and are not stated here; the list suggests yearly files, not a continuous series, and the latest listed files are for 2024. The aerodrome and heliport database is an asset inventory for exposure studies, and the traffic series support capacity planning and calibration of air network models for Mexico. It complements the Brazilian ANAC statistics and the global ACI airport traffic data.
